title.suggested: Tom Allen arraigned at Troy over Lincoln County prize fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen, Dan Daly, Ed Kelly, Tom Kelly and Artie Flint were arraigned at Troy, Mo., over a Lincoln County prize fight two years earlier; their cases were continued on $500 bonds.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, September 21, 1889, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen, with Dan Daly, Ed Kelly, Tom Kelly and Artie Flint, was arraigned before Judge Hughes in the Circuit Court at Troy, Mo., as a party to a prize fight in Lincoln County two years earlier; the cases were continued to the next term of court
places: Circuit Court, Troy, Lincoln County, Missouri

facts.fact: Each defendant was held in a $500 bond for his appearance, with Allen, Tom Kelly and Dan Daly becoming bondsmen for all; they were represented by N. C. Dryden of Troy and Mr. Boe of St. Louis
Allen and the other defendants traveled from St. Louis to Troy, Mo., for the arraignment and took the 4 o'clock train home the same day
